availability.description: A claim that a TNA product is bookable or available on a specific date.
blockingRules: tnaOptions.response.data.selectedDate must equal the claim selectedDate
tnaOptions.response.data.options must be a non-empty array
tnaCalendars.response.data.blockDates must not contain the claim selectedDate when calendar evidence is provided

instant_confirm.description: A claim that confirmation is instant.

option_price.description: A claim about an option-level numeric sale price.
blockingRules: Use options[].salePrice for option price claims
Do not treat items[].salePrice, priceDisplay, or basePrice as a final option price

search_starting_price.description: A claim about a search-result starting price only.
blockingRules: The wording must say starting price or equivalent
Do not present this as a final payment price
The claimed item must appear in included
The claimed item must appear in excluded

cancellation_policy.description: A claim about free cancellation or cancellation policy.
blockingRules: The documented TNA endpoints in this MVP do not expose a cancellation-policy field

relative_date.description: A claim that resolves a relative date such as today, tomorrow, this week, or next week.
blockingRules: currentDate is required before finalizing a relative date

reservation_or_payment_complete.description: A claim that a booking is confirmed, reservation is complete, or payment is complete.
blockingRules: This MVP has no reservation or payment tool

companion_suitability.description: A claim that the product is suitable for a companion condition such as parents, children, or mobility constraints.
blockingRules: Do not state suitability as a fact unless the cited detail fields directly support the condition
Use caveated wording when the evidence is indirect
